name: AnWP Football Leagues
author: Andrei Strekozov

sections.description:
AnWP Football Leagues turns WordPress into a football league or club website. Add your clubs, players and competitions, enter game results, and the plugin builds the rest: fixtures and results lists, standings tables, squads, player profiles and statistics. Standings and player stats are calculated automatically from your games, so you type a score once and every page updates. It handles round-robin leagues, knockout cups and multistage tournaments. It’s built for league organizers, clubs and football bloggers, and it’s free.

Running a site for another team sport (basketball, rugby, volleyball, ice hockey, handball, cricket, baseball)? Try Sports Leagues.

Competitions & Standings

  • Round-robin leagues, knockout cups and mixed multistage competitions with groups and rounds
  • Standings calculated automatically from game results
  • Ranking rules, including head-to-head and away goals
  • Initial points (+ or -) for clubs in a standings table
  • Custom row colors in standings, for clubs or for places (promotion, relegation)
  • Seasons and leagues to organize everything by year

Games

  • Lineups, substitutes, coaches and referees for every game
  • Game events: goals, cards, substitutions and penalty shootouts
  • Team statistics and video for each game
  • Postponed, cancelled and “time to be defined” game statuses
  • Countdown timer for upcoming games, as a block or a shortcode
  • Per-game player position (for example a field player who kept goal), with goalkeeper stats that follow it

Clubs & Players

  • Club pages with an active squad plus a season squad archive (number, position, status)
  • Player statistics calculated automatically from game events: minutes, goals, assists, cards, clean sheets
  • Player profiles with stats per season and a game list
  • Player Positions setting – cut the position set down (for example goalkeeper + field player for futsal)
  • Social links for clubs and players, including Telegram, WhatsApp, Threads, Bluesky, Twitch and Discord
  • Stadiums with photo, gallery, map and game list
  • Staff and referee profiles

Display: Blocks, Shortcodes, Widgets, Templates

  • Works with classic and block themes (Twenty Twenty-Five and other full-site-editing themes)
  • 7 Gutenberg blocks: Games, Next Game, Last Game, Game Countdown, Teams, Cards, Competition Header
  • 17 shortcodes with a Shortcode Builder and live preview
  • 11 widgets: Matches, Next Match, Last Match, Standing, Clubs, Players (scorers or assists), Player, Cards, Competition List, Birthdays, Video
  • Palette colors (primary, success, warning and more) for standing zones and result tints, or match the Kadence theme palette in one click
  • Stable fls- CSS classes on standings, match lists and headers, so your custom CSS survives plugin updates
  • Template system – override any layout from your theme
  • All settings on one page: Settings & Tools > Settings
  • XML sitemaps for games, players, clubs and other plugin pages
  • RTL support

Admin & Data

  • Data Import tool – paste rows from a spreadsheet to add clubs, players, staff, referees, stadiums and games, or batch-add lineups, goals, cards and substitutions
  • Standings recalculate after a games import
  • CSV export for clubs, players, games, stadiums, staff and referees
  • Translations: 12 languages included, plus Translations > Text Strings to rename any label from the admin
  • Object cache support (Redis, Memcached) detected automatically
  • Plenty of actions and filters for developers

Need custom features for your league or club site? I build them – tell me what you need.

Links and Documentation

Plugin Demo | Plugin Overview | Documentation | Start Guide | Available Shortcodes

Football Leagues PRO

Want more? Football Leagues PRO adds live scores, a drag-and-drop Layout Builder, advanced statistics and API data import.

PRO Demo | Real Website Example

Live

  • Live scores and live commentary, entered by hand or imported from an API
  • Game Timeline with a live progress bar, including extra time
  • Penalty shootout with a kick grid by round, updated live
  • Send a game report by email

Layout Builder

  • Drag-and-drop layouts for game, team, player, competition, referee, stadium and staff pages
  • Team page blocks: Roster, Staff, Season Record, Player Stats, Trophies, Gallery, partial standings and more
  • Competition page blocks: Season Leaders and display conditions by competition status
  • Dark color scheme, Live accent color and a Style Editor – click any Football Leagues element on your page and change its colors, fonts and spacing per device

Competitions & Standings

  • Tournament bracket (automatic or manual)
  • Standings: manual edit, column order and visibility, stat columns (corners, cards, any custom stat), conferences, position arrows
  • Results Matrix, Calendar, Calendar Slider and matchweek slides
  • Card suspensions with automatic bans and a Suspension Risk list

Statistics

  • Custom player and team stats, including calculated and formula columns, per-game and per-90 averages
  • Player and referee stats panels, Club Form Trends, head-to-head team stats
  • Charts: team stats and goals per 15-minute interval

Data & SEO

  • Import teams, players, games, lineups, events and live scores from API-Football (needs your own API subscription)
  • Transfers, club history (historical names and logos) and Entity Links
  • schema.org structured data (JSON-LD) on game, club, player, stadium, staff and referee pages, joined to the Yoast SEO or Rank Math graph
  • Dynamic SEO titles and descriptions
  • Automatic user timezone and AI game reports
  • 30+ shortcodes and premium support

Find out more about Football Leagues PRO

Ready-made club website designs

Want a finished club website without building every page yourself? AnWP Club Kit adds 7 club site designs on top of Football Leagues PRO. Pick one and your home page, news, fixtures, table and squad pages, header and footer are set up in a few minutes. You can swap the design or remove it in one click. It needs Football Leagues PRO and the free Kadence theme.

Source code and third-party libraries

Every minified script the plugin builds itself ships with a readable copy in the same folder (for example admin/js/admin-core.min.js and admin/js/admin-core.js).

These libraries are bundled in their upstream minified form:

  • baguetteBox.js 1.11.1 – MIT – github.com/feimosi/baguetteBox.js – vendor/baguette-box/
  • Flickr’s Justified Gallery (fjGallery) 2.1.2 – MIT – github.com/nk-o/flickr-justified-gallery – vendor/flickr-justified-gallery/
  • Micromodal 0.4.10 – MIT – github.com/ghosh/Micromodal – vendor/micromodal/
  • Plyr 3.8.3 – MIT – github.com/sampotts/plyr – vendor/plyr/

  • toastr 2.1.4 – MIT – github.com/CodeSeven/toastr – vendor/toastr/

    includes/customizer/so-css-inspector-mod.js is a modified copy of the CSS inspector from SiteOrigin CSS 1.5.1 – GPL – github.com/siteorigin/so-css.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or greater (PHP 8.1 or greater is recommended)
  • WordPress 6.5 or greater
  • CMB2 plugin
  • WordPress REST API enabled

Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “AnWP Football Leagues”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Install and activate the required CMB2 plugin.
  5. Follow the start guide on the plugin dashboard (Football Leagues > Dashboard) to set up your first competition.
sections.faq:
Will it work with my theme?

Yes. It works with classic themes (Kadence and others) and block themes (Twenty Twenty-Five and other full-site-editing themes) out of the box, and you can override any plugin layout from your theme. If something looks off, ask on the support forum.

My block theme’s Single Posts template changes don’t show on game or club pages

On a block theme (Twenty Twenty-Five, Twenty Twenty-Four and the like) with WordPress 6.7 or later, the plugin adds its own templates for game, club, player, competition, stadium, referee, staff and standing pages. They show the title and the plugin content, without the post meta and “More posts” list a blog post template adds. So edits to your theme’s general Single Posts template no longer reach these pages. To add a banner or sidebar, edit “Single Club”, “Single Match” and so on in Appearance > Editor > Templates.

Why does it need the CMB2 plugin?

Some admin edit screens are built on CMB2, a free and widely used plugin for custom fields. Install and activate it from Plugins > Add New. Football Leagues shows a notice with an install link if it’s missing.

Can I translate it or rename labels?

Yes. 12 translations come with the plugin (Danish, Dutch, French, German, Greek, Italian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Romanian, Russian, Slovenian, Spanish), and community translations from translate.wordpress.org fill any gaps and add more languages. You can help translate there too. To change any single label without a translation file, use Translations > Text Strings in the admin menu. Country names can be renamed there too.

Can I import data instead of typing it?

Yes. The Data Import tool (Settings & Tools > Data Import) takes rows pasted from a spreadsheet: clubs, players, staff, referees, stadiums, games, and batches of lineups, goals, cards and substitutions. You can export the same data to CSV. Automatic import from an external football data API is a PRO feature.

What’s the difference between the free and PRO versions?

The free plugin is a full league and club website: competitions, games, standings, squads, player stats, blocks, shortcodes and widgets. Football Leagues PRO adds live scores and commentary, the Layout Builder and Style Editor, tournament brackets, transfers, results matrix, advanced statistics and charts, structured data for search engines, API data import and more.

Is there a ready-made club site design?

Yes. AnWP Club Kit gives you 7 club website designs built on Football Leagues. Pick one and your home page, news, fixtures, table and squad pages are set up in a few minutes. It needs Football Leagues PRO and the free Kadence theme.

Will it slow my site down?

The plugin stores clubs, competitions, standings and squads in its own database tables, and it uses your object cache (Redis, Memcached) automatically when one is active. For a match list shown on every page (footer, sidebar), add cache="3600" to the [anwpfl-matches] shortcode to cache its output for an hour.

Do you build custom features?

Yes. If your league or club needs something the plugin doesn’t do, I take custom development work. Tell me about it here: anwp.pro/#services

  • Fix – translations from translate.wordpress.org now fill the labels the bundled translation leaves untranslated, Text Strings save on servers with max_input_vars = 1000, and text settings keep backslashes (“j \d\e F”).
  • Fix – Editors and other users who can edit a competition, standing or club no longer get errors when fixing game statuses, loading standing data, creating a league or season, or adding a player to a squad.

  • Fix – game editor: player minutes update on the first save after a Full Time change (Toolbox > Toolkit > Recalculate Player Minutes repairs finished games), renamed positions show on lineup badges and in the squad editor, and Edit Structure follows clubs moved between knockout ties.
  • Security – author privacy hardening in embeds, feeds, sitemaps and the REST API.
  • Security – “load more” game requests are capped, and the unused club list REST routes are now admin-only.
  • Fix – Data Import: pasting more rows than the table holds no longer writes values into the wrong columns, and typing after moving with the arrow keys edits the highlighted cell instead of the last clicked one.
  • Fix – player pages show the Home/Away letter in Cyrillic and other non-Latin languages, and lineup icons keep their size on themes with Font Awesome 4 styles (Salient).
  • Fix – database updates are retried when a new column was not added, and goalkeepers are found on databases whose tables use different collations.

short_description: Build a football league or club website in WordPress: fixtures, results, automatic standings, squads and player statistics.
description:
AnWP Football Leagues turns WordPress into a football league or club website. Add your clubs, players and competitions, enter game results, and the plugin builds the rest: fixtures and results lists, standings tables, squads, player profiles and statistics. Standings and player stats are calculated automatically from your games, so you type a score once and every page updates. It handles round-robin leagues, knockout cups and multistage tournaments. It’s built for league organizers, clubs and football bloggers, and it’s free.

Running a site for another team sport (basketball, rugby, volleyball, ice hockey, handball, cricket, baseball)? Try Sports Leagues.

Source code and third-party libraries

Every minified script the plugin builds itself ships with a readable copy in the same folder (for example admin/js/admin-core.min.js and admin/js/admin-core.js).

These libraries are bundled in their upstream minified form:

  • baguetteBox.js 1.11.1 – MIT – github.com/feimosi/baguetteBox.js – vendor/baguette-box/
  • Flickr’s Justified Gallery (fjGallery) 2.1.2 – MIT – github.com/nk-o/flickr-justified-gallery – vendor/flickr-justified-gallery/
  • Micromodal 0.4.10 – MIT – github.com/ghosh/Micromodal – vendor/micromodal/
  • Plyr 3.8.3 – MIT – github.com/sampotts/plyr – vendor/plyr/

  • toastr 2.1.4 – MIT – github.com/CodeSeven/toastr – vendor/toastr/

    includes/customizer/so-css-inspector-mod.js is a modified copy of the CSS inspector from SiteOrigin CSS 1.5.1 – GPL – github.com/siteorigin/so-css.
